name: Semantic-Sense
description: A hybrid anomaly-detection library for tabular data that combines semantic embeddings of categorical/text features with numeric signals to flag outliers. Recognizes semantic relationships — "bread" is closer to "sandwich" than to "meat" — making it far more accurate than numeric-only approaches on mixed-type datasets.
longDescription: Most anomaly detection libraries treat categorical columns as plain labels or drop them entirely. Semantic-Sense encodes them as dense vectors using lightweight sentence embeddings, then fuses those vectors with numeric signals in a unified scoring pipeline. The result: contextually-aware outlier detection that understands that a transaction category of 'grocery' near a 'pharmacy' purchase is less anomalous than one near 'casino'.
